body: Coi Leray explains the meaning behind her upcoming album Multi and how it represents her versatility as an artist. “I have so many different versions of me… I think it’s important to embrace every side of you,” she says. The rapper also reflects on balancing motherhood with her music career and hopes the project encourages women to embrace every side of themselves.
